description: This Java class 'HumanResEvents' appears to handle server-side logic related to human resources, specifically dealing with organizational hierarchies and employee details, and generating data structures for a tree view UI component based on entity queries.

classes.name: HumanResEvents
classes.description: A class providing static methods for retrieving organizational and employee data for human resources, used within a web application context.

methods.name: getChildHRCategoryTree
methods.description: Retrieves hierarchical organizational data related to a party, including current employee details, child departments, and employees within a company or party, and sets the data in request attribute for UI rendering.

methods.name: getCurrentEmployeeDetails
methods.description: Fetches details of current employees and their fulfillments based on a party ID, returning a list suitable for UI representation.

methods.name: getChildComps
methods.description: Retrieves child organizational units and their associated employees under a specific party group, formatted for a tree structure.

methods.name: getEmployeeInComp
methods.description: Fetches employees within a specified company or party, including their roles and statuses, for display in organizational hierarchy.
